newsitem.title: USA: Michigan jobless rate inches up in September.
newsitem.headline: Michigan jobless rate inches up in September.

text.p: Michigan's unemployment rate for September climbed to 4.7 percent from 4.5 percent in August, the state's employment security commission reported Wednesday.

"The strength of the economy and the favorable job outlook drew workers into the job market last month," said F. Robert Edwards, the commission's director, in a news release. "While most were able to find jobs, some were not and, consequently, unemployment increased."

Seasonablly adjusted estimates by the commission showed 226,000 unemployed workers last month, compared to 217,000 in August. In September 1995, Michigan's jobless rate was 5.2 percent with 247,000 people out of work.
The commission also reported that the number of employed workers reached a record high 4.63 million in September, a jump of 22,000 from August.
